narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.54 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.004123-0.004170 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.004238; the first objective pays 1.21R at 0.004089.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.004238 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.21 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 40/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, bid-wall floor

factors.detail: long liq $16.5M -2.6% below · short liq $3.9M +3.9% above
